LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_WallBloodline.label: [Raven] Wall Bloodline
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_WallBloodline.description:
A bizarre bloodline derived from solid walls. Though it sounds utterly ridiculous, it makes the bearer's bones and skin as dense as brick and stone, greatly reducing all incoming damage.

Effects:
- Incoming damage multiplier x0.9
